% Eqs. (4)-(9): basis functions of the isotypic components (phi = golden ratio), generated by the projectors; Eq. (11): P6
\begin{align*}
\ell=1,\ T_{1u}:\quad x &= x \\ y &= y \\ z &= z \\
\ell=2,\ H_g:\quad xy &= x y \\ yz &= y z \\ zx &= x z \\ x^2-y^2 &= x^{2} - y^{2} \\ 2z^2-x^2-y^2 &= -x^{2} - y^{2} + 2 z^{2} \\
\ell=3,\ T_{2u}:\quad f_x &= -3 \varphi x z^{2} + x^{3} + x y^{2} (3 \varphi - 3) \\ f_y &= -3 \varphi x^{2} y + y^{3} + y z^{2} (3 \varphi - 3) \\ f_z &= -3 \varphi y^{2} z + x^{2} z (3 \varphi - 3) + z^{3} \\
\ell=3,\ G_u:\quad g_x &= x^{3} + x y^{2} (-\varphi - 1) + x z^{2} (\varphi - 2) \\ g_y &= x^{2} y (\varphi - 2) + y^{3} + y z^{2} (-\varphi - 1) \\ g_z &= x^{2} z (-\varphi - 1) + y^{2} z (\varphi - 2) + z^{3} \\ xyz &= x y z \\
\ell=4,\ G_g:\quad u_0 &= x^{4} - 3 x^{2} y^{2} - 3 x^{2} z^{2} + y^{4} - 3 y^{2} z^{2} + z^{4} \\ u_x &= -\varphi y z^{3}/3 + x^{2} y z + y^{3} z (\varphi/3 - \tfrac{1}{3}) \\ u_y &= -\varphi x^{3} z/3 + x y^{2} z + x z^{3} (\varphi/3 - \tfrac{1}{3}) \\ u_z &= -\varphi x y^{3}/3 + x^{3} y (\varphi/3 - \tfrac{1}{3}) + x y z^{2} \\
\ell=4,\ H_g:\quad v_x &= x^{4} - 3 x^{2} y^{2} - 3 x^{2} z^{2} - y^{4}/2 + 6 y^{2} z^{2} - z^{4}/2 \\ v_y &= -x^{4}/2 - 3 x^{2} y^{2} + 6 x^{2} z^{2} + y^{4} - 3 y^{2} z^{2} - z^{4}/2 \\ v_z &= -x^{4}/2 + 6 x^{2} y^{2} - 3 x^{2} z^{2} - y^{4}/2 - 3 y^{2} z^{2} + z^{4} \\ w_x &= x^{2} y z + y^{3} z (\tfrac{1}{15} - 7 \varphi/15) + y z^{3} (7 \varphi/15 - \tfrac{2}{5}) \\ w_y &= x^{3} z (7 \varphi/15 - \tfrac{2}{5}) + x y^{2} z + x z^{3} (\tfrac{1}{15} - 7 \varphi/15) \\ w_z &= x^{3} y (\tfrac{1}{15} - 7 \varphi/15) + x y^{3} (7 \varphi/15 - \tfrac{2}{5}) + x y z^{2} \\
P_6 &= x^{6} + x^{4} y^{2} (3 - 21 \varphi) + x^{4} z^{2} (21 \varphi - 18) + x^{2} y^{4} (21 \varphi - 18) + 90 x^{2} y^{2} z^{2} + x^{2} z^{4} (3 - 21 \varphi) + y^{6} + y^{4} z^{2} (3 - 21 \varphi) + y^{2} z^{4} (21 \varphi - 18) + z^{6} \\
\sum_i (\hat a_i\cdot\hat n)^6 &= \tfrac{-2}{35}\,P_6 + \tfrac{6}{7}\,r^6 \quad(\text{Eq. 10 on the unit sphere})
\end{align*}
